title: Nakagawa Recomp Enhancement Package Declaration v1
description: Declaration for optional host enhancement or mod packages layered above authentic execution. Raw commercial guest addresses, proprietary game bytes, and untrusted scripts are strictly forbidden.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the enhancement package declaration (must be 1).

display_name.description: Human-readable name of the enhancement package.

experimental.description: false when the maintainer has released the package out of Experimental (docs/ENHANCEMENT_CONTRACT.md section 9.10). A package without it is experimental, and the player honours false only in a package found in the source tree's assets/enhancements/, never in one from the user's data folder.

category.description: Enhancement category defining its observation and mutation boundary.

target_title_id.description: Target title identifier or '*' for title-agnostic universal packages.

items.description: Named symbolic capability requested by the package.

symbol.description: Symbolic name of the hook target; raw address literals (e.g. 0x...) are strictly forbidden.

type.description: Hook interception point relative to the target symbol.

game_version.description: Target game release version string (e.g. '1.01') for timing rescale packages.

executable_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the expected original guest executable.

mode.description: Per-update RNG handling mode at rescaled logic rates.

reason.description: Documented rationale for the chosen RNG policy.

id.description: Symbolic site identifier; raw address literals are forbidden.

function.description: Symbolic function name; raw address literals and decompiler stems are forbidden.

insn_offset.description: Byte offset of the site's first instruction word from the function entry; a multiple of 4.

stock_digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the expected stock 32-bit instruction word(s).

word_count.description: Number of contiguous 32-bit stock instruction words covered by stock_digest; only 1 has a defined rewrite today.

transform.description: Declarative site transform class: a frame-rate rescale, or (clip_x_widen, category guest_memory_code_hook only) a widening of the title's own visibility test (contract section 10.8). value_reference rewrites nothing: the site pins a stock float that other sites reference (contract section 9.2).

clip_register.description: clip_x_widen only: the result register that holds the guest pointer the call at the site returns.

clip_offsets.description: clip_x_widen only: byte offsets from that pointer of the column-major 4x4 float clip matrices whose x output row the runtime scales.

arguments.description: argument_x2 only: the argument registers the site doubles at the function entry.

operand.description: What the site's lui builds when its encoding cannot say: f64_high is the upper word of a double (power-of-two scales only).

acceleration_site.description: launch_velocity_x0.5 only: the accel_x0.25 site of the per-update acceleration; that site must pin its whole float (word_count 2 or low_insn_offset).

step_site.description: gate_30hz_phase and launch_from_rest_60hz only: the site that pins h, the stock logic step: a value_reference site, or the step_x0.5 site that halves the step (a lui/ori pair, or an lwc1 or lv.s of read-only data). The resolver reads the value from the executable.

gravity_site.description: launch_from_rest_60hz only: the value_reference site that pins g, the stock acceleration on gravity_axis.

damping_site.description: velocity_source_x_kappa and launch_from_rest_60hz only: the value_reference site that pins c, the stock damping coefficient.

damping_step_site.description: velocity_source_x_kappa and launch_from_rest_60hz only: the value_reference site that pins L, the step the stock damping multiplies c by; the stock retention per update is 1 - c*L, which must lie in (0, 1).

phase_time.description: gate_30hz_phase only: where the state's own time is read, a float at offset from the pointer in a callee-saved register. The phase is the number of updates since that time was zero, found by matching the float against the state's own float32 sum of the 60 Hz step.

odd_phase_condition.description: gate_30hz_phase on a compare only: the value the FPU condition flag takes half a stock step after a stock instant.

velocity_offset.description: launch_from_rest_60hz only: the offset from the pointer in $a0 of the body's two velocity floats, which the called function must store itself. A package with such a site names the capability launch_velocity_write.

gravity_axis.description: launch_from_rest_60hz only: which of the two velocity floats gravity acts on.

low_insn_offset.description: For a lone lui of a float: the offset of the ori that completes it, read (not rewritten) to know the whole value.

low_stock_digest.description: SHA-256 of the stock word at low_insn_offset.

stock_values.description: swc1 or sw store sites only (sw needs it): the values the loader may store here. Any other value at run time stops the run; these are scaled and logged as they are stored.

requires.description: Ids of other sites that declare stock_values. This site runs its rewrite only after each has applied in the run; until then it runs its stock statement.

alternates.description: gate_30hz_alt only: the functions called in place of the gated call on the updates it skips, in the order the gated function calls them (contract section 9.2).

stock_value_digests.description: swc1 or sw store sites only, in place of stock_values (a published package's form, docs/ENHANCEMENT_CONTRACT.md section 5.1): HMAC-SHA-256 under the executable's digest key of the tag "stock value" and a NUL, the site id and a NUL, and each stock value's 32 bits, little-endian. The run-time check digests the value being stored; any other value stops the run.

update_boundary.description: The instruction where one logic update begins; it must run exactly once per update. Gated sites run on alternate updates counted here, so a package with gated sites declares it.

function.description: Symbolic function name; raw address literals and decompiler stems are forbidden.

insn_offset.description: Byte offset of the boundary instruction word from the function entry; a multiple of 4.

stock_digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the expected stock 32-bit instruction word.

data_sites.description: Constants in the executable's initialised data, rescaled once after the executable is loaded and before it runs, only while SR_EXPERIMENTAL_60HZ=1. The loaded bytes must equal the stock bytes or the run stops.

id.description: Symbolic identifier; raw address literals are forbidden.

symbol.description: Symbolic data label, resolved through the ELF symbols or the package's symbols sidecar.

offset.description: Byte offset from the label; a multiple of the element size.

stock_digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the stock bytes of all elements.

data_files.description: Files the title reads from its disc, rewritten when the title opens them while SR_EXPERIMENTAL_60HZ=1. A file whose bytes do not match sha256 stops the run.

id.description: Symbolic identifier; raw address literals are forbidden.

path.description: Path from the disc root, compared without case.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the stock file.

header_row.description: Zero-based line holding the column names.

first_data_row.description: Zero-based first data line; it follows header_row.

column.description: ASCII column name from the header line.

column_index.description: Zero-based column number, for a header that is not an ASCII name.

rows.description: Zero-based data-row indexes; all data rows when left out.

type.description: Type the title parses the cell into; inferred from a decimal point when left out.

ace_parts.description: Per-title Ace parts (docs/ENHANCEMENT_CONTRACT.md section 9.8), timing packages only. Each part is gated at run time by its own SR_ACE key, never by SR_EXPERIMENTAL_60HZ. Its sites share one id and instruction namespace with sites and update_boundary: an ace_parts site may not reuse an id or cover a word either already covers, may not declare requires, and no requires may name it.

load.description: Short loads (SR_ACE load=fast, section 11.3.10): display waits that only pace a loading screen.

id.description: Symbolic site identifier, unique across sites and every ace part; raw address literals are forbidden.

function.description: Symbolic function name; raw address literals and decompiler stems are forbidden. A vblank_wait_skip site may not be in the update_boundary's function.

insn_offset.description: Byte offset of the site's instruction word from the function entry; a multiple of 4.

stock_digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the expected stock 32-bit instruction word (keyed in a published package).

word_count.description: An ace part site is one instruction word.

transform.description: vblank_wait_skip: the site is a jal to the sceDisplayWaitVblankStart import stub; while load=fast is in effect the call is skipped and $v0 is 0.

published_package.description: Present only in a published package (docs/ENHANCEMENT_CONTRACT.md section 5.1): the published format version (must be 1). A published package carries no game bytes: its stock digests are keyed by the executable, and it may not declare stock_values.

disc_id.description: Published package only: the PARAM.SFO DISC_ID of the one disc it applies to. Another disc is refused as other_disc.

disc_version.description: Published package only: the PARAM.SFO DISC_VERSION it applies to. Another version is refused as other_revision; a matching disc ID and version with another executable_sha256 is refused as modified_executable.

digest_scheme.description: Published package only: every stock digest (stock_digest, low_stock_digest, a data site's stock_digest, a data file's sha256) is HMAC-SHA-256 of the stock bytes under a key derived from the whole executable, so it reveals nothing without the executable. A mismatch is refused as site_mismatch.

site_map.description: Published package only: each symbolic name the package uses and its 4-byte-aligned address in the executable, as codegen loads it. It names every used symbol and no other.

then.description: A published package (docs/ENHANCEMENT_CONTRACT.md section 5.1) keeps its text short: a version without build metadata, and a bounded rng_policy reason. The publication audit also refuses an address, a run of more than 8 hex digits, a base64-like run or an escaped byte in any string outside the digest slots and site-map addresses.
